posts.text: While I agree with your analysis when you look at it from the business point of view, however, in my opinion, this is a good company from investment point of view - Current valuation is fair Management seems honest and knowing the business better - maintaining a good ROCE For the size of this company, oversupply is not a problem. Per management, they are able to pass on the cost to customer so margin shouldn’t be a problem Power industry is already seeing huge demand and in my opinion, good transformer companies won’t see order or margin pressure for next 3-4 years atleast There is a high prob…
